I1.quote: The calibration for void volume was performed with ultrahigh purity helium. Then, hydriding reactions were performed at 45 ◦ C by a progressive increase in the hydrogen pressure from 0.01 to 50 bar (in 25 steps).
I1.location: main, p. 4, Section 2.3 Hydrogen Uptake Measurements

I2.quote: Two biocarbon samples were synthesized from Sargassum spp. The first was activated with KOH (SKPT) and the second was doped with sulfur (SSKTP); both were obtained through pyrolysis at 900 ◦ C.
I2.location: main, p. 1, Abstract; carbon content in Table 1, p. 5 (C 64.04 wt% SKTP, 61.96 wt% SSKTP)

I3.quote: The SSKTP exhibited a 20% improvement in hydrogen storage capacity (0.40 wt% at 50 bar and 45 °C) compared to the SKTP (0.33 wt%).
I3.location: main, p. 10, Section 4 Conclusions (also Figure 7 caption, p. 10: isotherms at 45 °C up to 50 bar)

I4.quote: Through the BET analysis, a surface area of 1670 m2 g−1 was calculated for the SKTP; this sample was activated with KOH.
I4.location: main, p. 4, Section 3.1 (also Table 1, p. 5: SBET 1670 and 2377 m2 g−1)

I5.quote: This research focuses on the synthesis and characterization of advanced materials for hydrogen storage.

notes: Gas-phase H2 PCI isotherms (Quantachrome Isorb-100, helium void-volume calibration, i.e. volumetric/Sieverts) at 45 °C (318 K), 0.01-50 bar, adsorption and desorption branches, Figure 7 (p. 10). The abstract and conclusions use the word 'electrocatalytic', but no electrolyte charging is reported; the hydrogen is gas-phase, so not electrochemical. Both sorbents are KOH-activated Sargassum biocarbons; Table 1 CHNS gives C 64.04 wt% (SKTP) and 61.96 wt% (SSKTP, S 17.45 wt%), so carbon is the majority component (S-doped carbon). Sample labels are inconsistent in the paper (SKPT/SKTP/SKPH; SSKTP/SSKPT/SSKPH). SKTP BET area is 1670 m2 g-1 in Section 3.1 and Table 1 but 1620 m2 g-1 in the abstract and conclusions. No retraction notice and no statement that the uptake data were published before. The text layer of pp. 3 and 6-9 contains overlaid duplicate text from a peer-review version; page images 5 and 10 were checked for Table 1 and Figure 7.
